integrity: The algebraic identities were replayed using exact polynomial and rational computations; the proof supplies infinite-parameter sign arguments. General prior-work methods and the equispaced special case are not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: Five periodic P1 elements; four identical short lengths and one length ratio h>=1; one backward Euler step. No arbitrary mesh, discrete-time positivity for other methods, or semigroup classification. Some specialized historical full texts could not be examined.
title: Sharp subquadratic positivity threshold on a one-defect periodic finite-element ring
